title: Registered Nurse — Medical ICU (Nights)
description:
St. Anselm Regional Medical Center is a 410-bed Level II trauma center and Magnet-designated hospital serving the Inland Northwest. Our 24-bed Medical ICU cares for critically ill adult patients: sepsis, respiratory failure, complex titratable drips, CRRT, and post-arrest targeted temperature management.

We are hiring a night-shift Registered Nurse (0.9 FTE, 7p–7:30a, self-scheduling) for the MICU.

What you'll do:
• Deliver total patient care for 1–2 critically ill adults per shift under our acuity-based staffing model
• Titrate vasoactive and sedation drips per protocol; manage ventilated patients in coordination with respiratory therapy
• Run CRRT and assist with bedside procedures (central lines, arterial lines, intubation)
• Document assessments, interventions, and I&O in Epic; medication administration via barcode scanning and Pyxis
• Participate in interdisciplinary rounds, bedside shift report, and rapid response / code blue teams
• Precept new graduate nurses after one year (paid preceptor differential)

Requirements:
• Current unencumbered Washington State RN license (or multistate compact license)
• BSN preferred; ADN accepted with BSN completion within 4 years
• BLS and ACLS required at hire (American Heart Association); NIHSS within 90 days
• Minimum 1 year acute-care RN experience; ICU, stepdown, or ED preferred
• CCRN certification preferred (certification differential $1.50/hr)
• Familiarity with evidence-based practice bundles (CLABSI, CAUTI, VAP prevention) and Joint Commission documentation standards

Compensation $41.80–$62.90/hr depending on experience, plus night differential $6.00/hr and weekend differential $4.50/hr. Sign-on bonus $15,000 with 2-year commitment. Relocation assistance available.
